interpreted_intent: Create an adult harem-romance ensemble scene whose visible one-center and three-or-more-partner topology can be strictly tested in a complex photographic setting.
subject: One clearly adult central traveler guided by the supplied appearance reference and at least three distinct clearly adult potential partners.
setting: A glass-roof railway concourse at night after a rain-stalled arts festival, with wet reflections and layered travel activity.
event: Three potential partners simultaneously direct different practical invitations or help offers to the same central adult, who manages the overlap while the partners notice one another.
visual_priorities: The one-center and three-or-more-partner relation reads immediately before the atmospheric station detail.
Every offer object, directed hand action, center response, and cross-partner awareness cue remains separately visible.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a complex photorealistic adult harem-romance ensemble scene at a rain-stalled glass-roof railway concourse after a night arts festival. The central adult's visible appearance follows the supplied reference: long dark wavy hair with a near-center part, dark eyes, softly defined natural makeup, and front-facing facial proportions. Keep this clearly adult traveler fully visible at the center. At least three clearly adult potential partners approach from separated paths at the same moment. One offers a dry umbrella, one presents a hot drink and folded scarf, and one extends a replacement train ticket with a route map; each action is directed to the central adult. She raises one hand to sequence the offers while holding the other items, and the partners pause, exchange cross-glances, and adjust around one another, visibly registering the overlap. Use wet floor reflections, distant disrupted-travel activity, layered glass architecture, and a medium-wide editorial frame that keeps every hand, object, gaze, and full-group relation readable.
